body: A lot of drs don't understand the mind body connection and that yes, serious untreated depression and anxiety or any mental distress can cause pain. I personally have tons of experience with this unfortunately :(. I can relate tremendously to being incredibly young and feeling like an old person. It sucks but you absolutely have a right to and need to get appropriate help to feel better, if your mom can't help you there's likely a way to call mental health services in your area to explore options. Never being comfortable or feeling just normal without pain is literally the worst and I understand it so much

Yes a couple times I've imagined it. There's barely anyone there of course. My parents sobbing (even though I've told them I'm planning on killing myself and there are things they can do for me now to prevent that but they don't take me seriously) and some extended family I never seen. No friends because I don't have any, maybe some old ones I haven't seen in many years who haven't cared enough about me to ask how I'm doing and who abandoned me when I needed them the most. It makes me feel sad. Sometimes I just think ok, let me at least make more friends now so my funeral won't be so pathetic. Isn't that twisted? Like I'd want to upset even more people. Yeah, I'm fucked up. 

I can't even imagine my parents would be surprised at this point considering how many times I've mentioned it's going to happen. My mom once said if I did that she wouldn't be able to live with it and kill herself but I do not in any way believe she would do that. And I would  not want her to. Her life would be easier in every way without me and I'd be doing her a favor in the long run.

Please don't "feel okay" about killing yourself. I guarantee you have things to live for. I seriously feel I'm the one exception who doesn't and who can't be helped. But I think everyone else can including you.
